label: Aristotle, Metaphysics IV.5, 1009a6-15: Every opinion held by any person is true, using one…
interpretation: Aristotle introduces the Protagorean account and considers the hypothesis that all opinions and appearances are true. This schema records the all-opinions component only, under a single truth predicate, without claiming that it is Protagoras’s own wording, a complete account of appearances, or every modern relativism. It is an attributed target, not Aristotle’s assent.
